title: Connection Agreements Coordinator
company: UK Power Networks (Operations) Ltd - Company - Permanent
description:
Connection Agreements Coordinator

30,816.00 7.5% bonus Permanent Energy House, Crawley RH10

Are you highly organised, accurate and confident communicating with customers? Join UK Power Networks as a Connection Agreements Coordinator and help ensure customer agreements and records are managed efficiently, securely and in line with regulatory requirements.

Working within Finance and reporting to the Billing and Agreements Manager, you will join a small team responsible for preparing and administering customer connection agreements and agreed variations. As a key contact for customers and their representatives, you will provide clear information, resolve enquiries and maintain complete, up-to-date records.

What you'll do:
- Prepare and administer connection agreements and agreed changes.
- Respond to customer enquiries by email and telephone, explaining available options clearly.
- Update standing data and connection records accurately.
- Monitor the issue, return and filing of agreements.
- Work with internal colleagues and external customers to obtain information and resolve queries.
- Handle sensitive information in line with UK GDPR, confidentiality and regulatory requirements.You will be a strong communicator who can organise a varied workload, manage high volumes of enquiries and maintain accurate records. You will also bring:
- Five GCSEs at grades 9-4 or A -C, including English and Mathematics, or equivalent qualifications or relevant practical experience.
- Experience building effective relationships with customers and stakeholders.
- Confidence using Microsoft Excel and Word.
- Strong attention to detail and an understanding of data protection and confidentiality.

Experience in customer data management, contract administration, the energy sector or another regulated environment would be advantageous, but is not essential. We welcome transferable experience from different career paths.

Benefits include: 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, a generous pension, reservist leave, season ticket and tenancy deposit loans, tax-efficient schemes, retailer and gym discounts, Occupational Health support and an Employee Assistance Programme.

Ready to bring your organisation, customer focus and attention to detail to UK Power Networks? Apply by 1 November 2026, quoting reference 82921.

For more information and to view the full job description please click apply!

If you have any queries in connection to this vacancy or your application, please contact us at quoting the vacancy reference number and a member of the team will get in touch with you as soon as possible.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant - Primary School

Location: Crawley
Hours: 15 hours per week, over 2 or 3 days
Pay: 13- 16 per hour, depending on experience
Start Date: November

Are you an organised and detail-focused finance professional looking for a part-time opportunity within a supportive primary school environment?

A welcoming primary school in Crawley is seeking a reliable and experienced Finance Assistant to join their team from November. This is an excellent opportunity for a Finance Assistant who is looking for flexible part-time hours and enjoys working in an education setting.

The Role

As Finance Assistant, you will play an important role in supporting the school's day-to-day financial administration. You will work closely with the school's administrative team to ensure financial processes are accurate, efficient and well maintained.

The successful Finance Assistant will be responsible for a range of financial and administrative duties, including:
- Processing invoices and payments
- General finance administration and record keeping
- Providing wider administrative support to the school when required

About You

We are looking for a Finance Assistant who is organised, trustworthy and confident working with financial information.

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience in a Finance Assistant or similar finance administration role
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Good organisational and time-management skills
- Confidence using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Excellent communication skills
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team
- A professional and approachable manner
- Ideally, previous experience working within a school or education environment, although this is not essential

What's on Offer
- Part-time hours of 15 hours per week over 2 or 3 days
- 13- 16 per hour, depending on experience
- Opportunity to work within a friendly and supportive primary school
- Convenient Crawley location
- Opportunity to contribute to the smooth running of a local school

If you are an experienced Finance Assistant seeking a part-time opportunity in Crawley, we would love to hear from you. This could be an ideal role for someone looking for flexibility while continuing to develop their finance experience within a supportive school environment.

Location: Crawley

To apply for this Finance Assistant position, please submit your CV for consideration.

This role is via Academics Recruitment Agency, acting on behalf of the school.

Salary will be determined by the successful candidate's qualifications and relevant experience, and will be in accordance with the client's pay policy.

title: HR & Payroll Administrator - Immediate Start
description:
HR & Payroll Coordinator - Immediate Start

Location: Crawley
Contract: Full-Time Temp
Salary: 17 - 19 PH PAYE

We are partnering with a well-established and highly respected organisation to recruit an experienced HR & Payroll Coordinator. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a busy and supportive team in a role that combines payroll administration with broader HR support responsibilities.

This position would suit a proactive individual who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, takes pride in accuracy, and is confident managing payroll processes while supporting employees and managers across a range of HR activities.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the end-to-end monthly payroll process, ensuring all employee data is accurate and submitted within deadlines.
- Maintain payroll records including starters, leavers, contractual changes, salary amendments and benefits updates.
- Act as a key point of contact for payroll-related queries from employees and stakeholders.
- Coordinate employee benefits administration, including pension and salary sacrifice schemes.
- Assist with payroll year-end activities, including statutory reporting requirements.
- Assist with the preparation and administration of annual P11 D and PSA submissions, ensuring compliance with HMRC requirements and deadlines.
- Provide administrative support across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, probation, contractual changes and offboarding.
- Maintain the HR system and employee records, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
- Produce HR and payroll reports as required.
- Support HR initiatives, projects and general employee relations administration.

About You
- Previous experience in a payroll and/or HR administration role.
- Experience supporting P11 D, PSA and employee benefits administration.
- Strong understanding of payroll processes and associated legislation.
- Previous experience working with payroll systems such as ADP or similar would be advantageous.
- Excellent attention to detail with a high level of accuracy.
- Confident using HR and payroll systems.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
- Ability to manage confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
- Excellent organisational and communication skills.
- Able to prioritise a varied workload and work effectively to deadlines.

What's on Offer?
- Friendly and collaborative working environment.
- Hybrid working arrangements.
- Varied role with exposure to both payroll and HR functions.

If you are an experienced HR and Payroll professional looking for your next opportunity and enjoy delivering a high-quality service in a busy environment, we would love to hear from you.

title: Office Coordinator / Sales Administrator - Immediate Start
description:
Office Coordinator / Sales Administrator

Location: Crawley
Salary: 30,000 - 35,000 (DOE)
Job Type: Full-time onsite, Monday to Friday 9am - 5:30pm

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Office Coordinator to join a busy and growing business. This is a varied role that combines office coordination, administration, and sales support responsibilities, making it ideal for someone who enjoys working across multiple functions and keeping operations running smoothly.

The successful candidate will be confident managing administration tasks, supporting customer orders, and working extensively with Excel to produce reports, manage data, and support business performance.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide day-to-day coordination and administration support across the office.
- Process customer orders, quotations, and sales-related documentation accurately.
- Maintain and update customer records, databases, and internal systems.
- Produce, analyse, and maintain Excel spreadsheets and reports.
- Support the sales team with order tracking, pricing updates, and client communications.
- Monitor stock, supplier information, and operational records where required.
- Coordinate meetings, travel arrangements, and general office logistics.
- Handle incoming calls and emails, ensuring a professional and timely response.
- Assist with reporting, KPI tracking, and data management projects.
- Support continuous improvement of office processes and administrative procedures.

About You
- Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data analysis, reporting, and spreadsheet management.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Comfortable working with large volumes of data and maintaining accuracy.
- Confident communicator with excellent customer service skills.
- Able to prioritise workloads and manage multiple tasks effectively.
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office and CRM/ERP systems.
- A proactive, positive, and solutions-focused approach.

What's on Offer
- Varied and interesting role with a mix of administration and sales support.
- Friendly and supportive team environment.
- Opportunity to take ownership of reporting and process improvements.
- Training and development opportunities.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.

If you're a highly organised administrator with strong Excel skills and experience supporting a busy office or sales team, we'd love to hear from you.
